findings.statement: Production responsibility: Own the register of supported unikernel toolchains: record each one's language support, maturity, security-response posture and known limitations, and refuse to select a toolchain for a workload whose requirements it does not actually meet.
Owns 5 concerns; explicitly disclaims 5.
3 declared dependencies across upstream/downstream/peer.
The source of truth is the signed register snapshot (r4, 4 entries); a one-field edit to it is refused as REG_INTEGRITY_FAILURE.
3 environment assumptions recorded.

Tenant/environment/site/workload boundaries defined: environment=production admits only mature toolchains; a beta toolchain only under an approved, unexpired, scoped waiver; experimental never (policy inv28-default r1, ADR-0001), site=a site supports a subset of architectures, hypervisors and providers; selection takes SiteCapabilities and never picks outside them, tenant=toolchain choice is not tenant-visible policy, workload=a workload declares language, runtime, devices, features and optional hypervisor/provider/ABI needs (PK_TOOLCHAIN_SELECTION_REQUEST/1), never a toolchain
7 mandatory capabilities separated from 3 optimizations.
4 unsupported patterns and non-goals documented.
Architecture decisions recorded against each owned concern.
Contract validates clean under pk_core.Contract.validate().
